title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Cash Price List for 30-Day Sensor Supplies
content:
Larkfield's cash price for a 30-day sensor supply on the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program is set per CGM model. The price is the self-pay price and the price of non-covered sensor supply, and it is the same on every tier.

| CGM model | Cash price per 30-day sensor supply |
|---|---|
| Dexcom G7 | 412.80 USD |
| Dexcom G7 15 Day | 412.80 USD |
| Dexcom G6 | 436.25 USD |
| FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus | 148.36 USD |
| FreeStyle Libre 2 Plus | 142.10 USD |

## Applying the list

- The price is quoted per 30 days of supply; a supply of several 30-day blocks is priced at the model's price for each block.
- The two Dexcom G7 entries share one price; the Dexcom G6 carries the highest price on the list.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

For a hypothetical model priced at 100.00 USD per 30 days, a 90-day supply is three 30-day blocks and is priced at three times 100.00 USD, that is 300.00 USD.
